gemini-3-flash.notes: Good CRA structure but has CVSS inaccuracies (CVE-2025-13465 shown as 8.2 vs actual 7.9/6.5, CVE-2025-7783 axios CVSS wrong). Covers all high-risk CVEs well.

gpt-4.1-mini.notes: Multiple CVSS errors (CVE-2025-13465 as 8.2, CVE-2025-64718 as 6.9 vs 5.3). Claims 4 additional PoCs without evidence. Verbose with some inaccuracies.

deepseek-v3.notes: Most accurate CVSS values, concise format, good CRA alignment. Minor issue with claiming CVE-2025-13465 as 8.2 instead of 7.9, but overall very solid.

analysis: Deepseek-v3 wins with the most accurate CVSS reporting and excellent conciseness while maintaining CRA compliance structure. Gemini-3-flash provides comprehensive coverage but has several CVSS inaccuracies. GPT-4.1-mini suffers from multiple factual errors and unsupported PoC claims.
